items.t: The Western Union Company Terminates Merger Agreement with International Money Express, Inc. on November 10, 2026
Why Western Union is trying to ditch its Intermex acquisition
items.sum: The $500 million deal fell apart Tuesday night after the deal’s last regulatory holdout, the California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation, granted the companies conditional approval to move forward.

items.t: Western Union’s USDPT Stablecoin Becomes a Settlement Option on Visa, Anchorage Digital Says
items.sum: Anchorage Digital said Visa partners can now pay their VisaNet balances in USDPT, the Western Union token its bank mints. Visa has not put out its own statement.
